purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are prioritization signals, not measured search volumes and not proof of eligibility, amount, deadline safety, decision or payment. Commercial pages and news language are discovery-only; material Villaeffekten claims require current primary-source verification.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volumes.

demand_signal.basis: The scheme is live from September 2026 and both Boverket and current market-facing pages prominently connect it to ordinary homeowner intents such as heat pumps and lower energy cost. This is a qualitative discovery signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: Natural language collapses materially different facts: ownership/permanent residence timing, tax value year versus build year, existing district-heating connection, exact measure/product, material-order date versus measure-start date, documents, material versus labour and decision/budget uncertainty.

miss_consequence.basis: A user can order material too early, miss a time-sensitive application route, budget around the wrong cost base, assume submission equals approval or abandon a potentially relevant measure. Work-start timing and material-order timing control different rule boundaries, so collapsing them can create a false positive even when the apparent renovation timeline looks safe.

source_fragmentation.basis: Boverket provides operational grant guidance, the current SFS carries material timing and decision rules, county boards decide applications, and Energimyndigheten/municipal advisers provide independent measure guidance. Commercial installer pages are useful for discovery language but cannot carry the truth boundary.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as Villaeffekten, energibidrag, värmepump, värdeår, fjärrvärme, materialkostnad, beställningsdatum and startdatum are easy to collapse into a misleading yes/no answer, with additional risk for users reading through translated or simplified language.

steps_to_action.basis: The safe path should be short but ordered: natural situation -> owner/residence-by-payment boundary -> value year -> existing district heating -> concrete measure -> one high-value timing step that keeps material order distinct from work start -> current primary-source check -> documents and county-board application, with an independent energy-advice fallback when the measure is unclear.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same misunderstandings recur across heat-pump, insulation, window and renovation contexts, while commercial pages repeatedly lead with simplified amounts and measure examples.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: After v34 the product had a normalized review-gated truth record and regressions but the common public situation shell still lacked a focused natural-language handoff. During v35 self-review, the first public route also collapsed residence timing and then work-start timing with material-order timing; both are now treated as distinct truth boundaries without creating a separate matcher.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Use the existing shared situation shell and person module to expose a bounded home-energy handoff. Ask only facts that change the Villaeffekten path, preserve residence-by-payment timing, keep material-order date distinct from measure-start date in one high-value timing step, keep the normalized support record review-gated, provide current Boverket/SFS verification and independent municipal energy advice, and turn every discovered product miss into regression memory. Do not build a separate energy app or matcher.
signals.truth_rule: Discovery pages and market language are signals, not truth. Verify material grant facts against current Boverket operational guidance and current SFS before they affect user-facing behavior. Energimyndigheten may support the independent-advice fallback. Do not infer eligibility, amount, deadline safety, county-board decision, budget reservation or material-cost eligibility from commercial claims, work-start date alone, a generic renovation story or prior AI output.
